body:
Closes #1596

## Summary

- default provider-contract activity checks to the trip departure date
- preserve explicit validator reference dates for historical or proposed policy evaluation
- keep advance-booking rules on their existing evaluation-date clock

## Tasks

- [x] Evaluate provider approval against trip departure by default.
- [x] Cover planner verdict and policy snapshot behavior.
- [x] Preserve explicit-date overrides and advance-booking semantics.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `tests/python/test_policy_api.py::test_check_trip_plan_uses_departure_date_for_provider_contract` fails on `origin/main` and passes on this branch.
- [x] Provider-rule coverage proves an explicit reference-date override is preserved.
- [x] The full repository test suite passes.

## Validation

- `python3 -m pytest -q` — 1282 passed, 1 skipped, 1 deselected, 3 xfailed
- focused policy/provider cohort — 111 passed, 1 skipped
- `python3 -m ruff check src tests` — passed
- `python3 -m mypy src` — passed across 52 source files
- `git diff --check` — passed
- deliberate-break verifier — named regression failed on `origin/main` with `PROV-DEPARTURE`, then passed on this branch

## Design note

Passing `plan.departure_date` through the shared validator reference date was rejected because it makes advance-booking rules see zero notice days. ProviderApprovalRule now supplies departure date only when no explicit reference date is provided.
